title: Merge two sorted chains
description:
Two regional systems each produce an event stream sorted by timestamp, stored as linked lists. You need one combined stream, still sorted.

A chain is a linked list built from dictionaries. Each node looks like `{"value": 1, "next": <node or None>}`, and an empty chain is `None`.

Write `merge_chains(a, b)` that merges two chains sorted ascending by `value` and returns the head of the merged chain. When values tie, take the node from `a` first.

**Example**

```
a = 1 -> 4 -> 9
b = 2 -> 4
merge_chains(a, b)   # 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 4 -> 9
```
hints: A placeholder first node saves you from special-casing the head. Build onto it, then return its `next`.
Keep a `tail` name pointing at the last node of the merged chain. Attach the smaller of the two front nodes and advance that chain.
When one chain runs out, attach whatever is left of the other in one step.
